$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFIK (AIP France, chart dated 2023-12-28): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty; the French of the procedures and of the points' purposes is not recorded.
name: Ribérac - Saint-Aulaye

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked
source.frenchExtraction: French column of the chart text, read by script and paired with the English sentences

notes: AD reserved for radio equipped ACFT.
RWY prohibited to paramotors.

Paramotors: Paramotor entry point: Crossroad of the D5 and the D43.
RWY 05 in use: proceed along road D43 avoiding flying over the AEM area.
RWY 23 in use: proceed along road D5 avoiding flying over the AEM area.
Paramotor TKOF and LDG prohibited if an aircraft is taxiing on TWY C.
Taxiing to RWY 05:.

From the ACB hangar: taxi viaTWY C then join holding point A via TWY B.
LDG: RWY backtrack prohibited.
Vacate RWY via holding point B and taxi via TWY B.
Taxiing to RWY 23:.
TKOF: Entry on RWY only via holding point B.
LDG: Vacate the RWY only via holding point A.
Taxiing on TWY C: TWY C reserved for aircraft parked in the Jean Mermoz ACB hangar.
Taxiing prohibited on TWY if a Paramotor is taking off or landing.
TKOF RWY 23: Due to the curved profile of the RWY, the THR 05 is not visible from the THR 23, extreme caution is advised before TKOF.
TKOF RWY 05: Caution in N-NE winds combined with the curved profile of the RWY.
AEM (NR 9138): 330 ft ASFC, HJ, as per protocol.
Paramotor activity: 500 ft ASFC, SR-SS.
AD réservé aux ACFT munis de radio.

RWY 05 en service : cheminer le long de la D43 en évitant le survol de la zone AEM.
RWY 23 en service : cheminer le long de la D5 en évitant le survol de la zone AEM.

LDG : Dégagement de la piste uniquement par le point d'attente A.
